integrity: All-n proof is a constructive orbit partition; independent finite verification tests are supplementary, not the proof. No independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Classical order-ideal rowmotion on S_n for n>=3 only; no claim for arbitrary height-two, birational or piecewise-linear actions. Earlier general antichain paper not inspected in full; exact literature priority remains uncertain.
title: Uniform rowmotion orbits and a sharp rank-average split on standard-example posets
